_comment: Per-1M-token USD on Vertex AI, ~2026-07. VERIFY against current Google Cloud / Anthropic pricing before quoting. Global endpoints; regional/multi-region carry a ~10% premium.
_gemini_flash_note: gemini_flash MUST track whatever the `flash` tier actually resolves to in agy-delegate.sh's model_for_tier(), because agy-cost-compare.sh picks this key by tier NAME, not by model. Today that is Gemini 3.5 Flash (High) — hence out 9.00. If you remap tier_flash to Gemini 3.6 Flash, its output is cheaper (7.50; in and cached-in unchanged) — see gemini_flash_36 and pass GEMINI_OUT_PER_M=7.50, or move those rates into gemini_flash when you make 3.6 your default.
_cache_note: cache_write_mult / cache_read_mult apply to the CLAUDE deck only. Gemini prices cached input at a flat rate (cached_in) and bills context-cache STORAGE by time, which agy does not report — so any Gemini-side figure you compute here is a LOWER BOUND.
